description: Schema for ingredient standardization and nutrition item classification in dietary knowledge graph construction.

raw_aliases.description: Original aliases split into a list

canonical_name.description: Normalized ingredient name used for search, mapping, and KG node merging

canonical_group.description: High-level group used by the application and knowledge graph

match_type.description: How this raw item relates to the canonical ingredient

entity_role.description: Practical role of the item in query and nutrition matching

is_base_food.description: Whether this item can serve as a base ingredient node in the KG

is_query_default.description: Whether this item may appear in default query results for the canonical ingredient

is_search_hidden_by_default.description: Whether to hide the item from default UI search results unless user expands or asks specifically

search_priority.description: Higher number means more suitable as a default representative item

specificity_score.description: How specific the raw item is relative to canonical_name

state_tags.description: Tags such as 生, 熟, 去皮, 帶骨, 無鹽, 低脂, 全脂, 嫩, 板

flavor_tags.description: Flavor descriptors such as 巧克力, 草莓, 布丁

brand_tags.description: Detected commercial or retailer brand tokens

exclude_reasons.description: Reasons why the item is hidden or excluded from default matching

representative_candidate_rank.description: Rank among siblings inside the same canonical_name

sibling_group_key.description: Key used to group similar variants, e.g. 牛奶::鮮乳::全脂

canonical_query_terms.description: Search terms that should map to the same canonical ingredient

recommended_pipeline: Detect exclusion, brand, flavor, and processing markers
Resolve canonical_name using alias map and lexical rules
Group sibling variants and pick representative items
Persist normalized index for query-time lookup

query_behavior.default_result_policy: Return only items where is_query_default=true, sorted by search_priority desc
query_behavior.expanded_result_policy: Include subtypes and processing variants, but still hide excluded commercial or heavily flavored products unless explicitly requested
